// CASE honest_worker_with_cast_elsewhere expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T, R>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	operation: (item: T) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
	let next = 0;
	const results: R[] = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}

export function stamp(rows: unknown[]) {
	for (const row of rows) {
		(row as { stamped: boolean }).stamped = true;
	}
}

// CASE per_item_in_same_file expect=fire
export async function saveAll(
	items: string[],
	put: (item: string) => Promise<void>,
) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await put(item);
	}
}
